purpose: Certify the frozen Repair32B reduced Z11 state without any H2 reintegration, using Repair31-motivated global normalization for state precision and constraints plus artifact-only reduced-operator re-evaluation.

Repair31.role: defines artifact-only global state/operator/constraint diagnostics; no H2 integration

certification_diagnostics.state_precision: Repair31 full-six-field global and dynamic S,u,varphi,T Nt128/Nt64 relative L2
certification_diagnostics.chi_parent: Repair31 artifact-only reduced chi11 versus frozen Repair29B R2 parent
certification_diagnostics.operator_main: re-evaluate unchanged reduced GE06+GE07 operator on frozen Repair32B NPZ using the corrected RHS stored in that NPZ
certification_diagnostics.source_free_rows: normalize global absolute residuals of lapse, isotropic-spatial, dust-potential and dust-density rows by one global main-operator scale
certification_diagnostics.constraints: Repair31 global shift/anisotropy L2 divided by global main-operator scale

full_six_field_global_Nt128_vs_Nt64_rela.origin: Repair30 preregistered state precision threshold, with Repair31 global normalization

driven_aether_scalar_operator_global_rel.origin: pre-Repair32B Repair31 artifact-only operator re-evaluation floor was O(1e-5) on the solved Repair30 state

source_free_main_rows_absolute_over_glob.origin: same artifact-only operator re-evaluation scale; avoids zero-RHS relative-residual pathology

shift_global_relative_to_operator_scale_.origin: Repair30 constraint threshold retained with Repair31 global operator-scale normalization

anisotropy_global_relative_to_operator_s.origin: Repair30 constraint threshold retained with Repair31 global operator-scale normalization

pass_requirements: Repair32B JSON/NPZ hashes exact and Repair32B classification PASS
Repair32B exact dictionary factor equals 2 and fitted_normalization_used is false
all Repair32B reconstruction validation gates are true
aether and scalar global operator residuals <= 1e-4
each source-free main-row absolute residual / global main-operator scale <= 1e-4

pass_license.next: Separately preregister H4/Z21 construction using Repair22 Z10/Z20, Repair27 q10/q20, certified Repair32C Z11, GE04 DY2, GE05 M1/M2 with the exact GE05->GE06 raw-residual dictionary, and the frozen reduced operator.

fail_route: Freeze Repair32C FAIL and localize the failed artifact-only gate. Do not reintegrate H2 or change thresholds in the same test.
